title: Stakeholder Mapping Tool
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners categorize four university stakeholders by buyer type (economic, technical, user) and influence type (coach, mobilizer, skeptic, friend), then see whom to prioritize and how to engage each.

learningObjectives: Categorize stakeholders into buyer types (Economic, Technical, User) and influence types (Coach, Mobilizer, Skeptic, Friend) for a given sales scenario.
prerequisites: Stakeholder definitions (Economic, Technical, and User Buyer; Coach, Mobilizer, Skeptic, Friend) in Chapter 1

keyQuestions: Categorize stakeholders into buyer types (Economic, Technical, User) and influence types (Coach, Mobilizer, Skeptic, Friend) for a given sales scenario.
commonMisconceptions: Economic buyers are always the most important.
Mobilizers and friends are the same.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct buyer and influence type for all four stakeholders.
Learner can explain why skeptics should be engaged with data, not avoided.
